name: Financial Consultant
seoTitle: Business Insurance Cost for Financial Consultants

industryContext.contextNote: Financial consultants advise clients on money decisions carrying real fiduciary weight, making professional-liability exposure the dominant risk rather than physical hazard.

riskFactors.title: Fiduciary Breach Claims
riskFactors.description: A client who suffers investment losses tied to advice may allege the consultant breached their fiduciary duty or gave negligent guidance.

riskFactors.title: Sensitive Financial Data Exposure
riskFactors.description: Consultants store account numbers, tax records, and financial plans, creating significant liability if that data is breached.

riskFactors.title: Regulatory & Compliance Disputes
riskFactors.description: Financial advice is subject to regulatory scrutiny, and compliance missteps can trigger costly investigations or claims.

faqs.question: Why do financial consultants need fiduciary Errors & Omissions coverage?
faqs.answer: Fiduciary E&O specifically covers claims that a consultant's investment or planning advice breached their duty of care, which standard General Liability does not address.

faqs.question: What is the average cost of business insurance for a financial consultant?
faqs.answer: A financial consultant in the $0-50k revenue tier pays an estimated $290 per year for baseline General Liability coverage.

faqs.question: Does a financial consultant need Cyber Liability insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes. Handling clients' financial account details and tax records creates significant data-breach exposure that a Cyber Risk endorsement is designed to cover.

faqs.question: Is General Liability enough for a financial consultant?
faqs.answer: No. General Liability covers bodily injury and property damage, not investment advice outcomes, so fiduciary E&O is considered essential for this profession.

blogContent.whyThisRiskFactor: Financial consultants carry a 1.25 actuarial risk factor, reflecting significant fiduciary and data-privacy exposure despite low physical premises risk.
blogContent.howCalculated: Premiums scale with revenue tier, team size, and fiduciary Errors & Omissions or Cyber Risk endorsements.
blogContent.comparisonNote: Financial consulting premiums rank among the higher professional-services tiers, above general business consulting, reflecting the added fiduciary liability.
